4.1.2 Lab: Find BIOS/UEFI Settings

Lab Tasks

    Student name

    Firmware key guide

    Dell: F2 (Setup), F12 (Boot menu)
    Many ASUS boards: Delete or F2
    HP: often Esc then F10
    Lenovo: often F1 or F2
    Actual keys depend on model.
    UEFI BIOS Utility (training)System powered off
    Teaching note: BIOS/UEFI menus vary by manufacturer and version. This simulator models common settings with a fictional firmware version and hardware inventory. It does not change a real device.
